tools.name: search_site_content
tools.description: Search this dog-training blog's published posts by keyword. Returns matching posts with their title, URL, tags, and a short excerpt. Use this whenever the visitor asks about a specific topic, technique, or dog sport discipline.

query.description: Keywords to search for in post titles, tags, and content

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List posts on this blog that include an embedded training video, optionally filtered by a topic keyword. Use this when the visitor asks for video recommendations or wants to see something in action.

topic.description: Optional keyword to filter video posts by topic (omit to list all video posts)

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email on the site owner's behalf. Not implemented yet - this entry exists so the capability can be enabled later without restructuring the tool system.

tools.name: check_calendar
tools.description: Check the site owner's calendar for availability. Not implemented yet - this entry exists so the capability can be enabled later without restructuring the tool system.
